changelog:
1.7.6 - Manual IP Fix
  FIXED: IP and port fields now properly accept input and switch focus
1.7.5 - Hotspot IP Fix
  ADDED: Multiplayer support when one device is a hotspot
  ADDED: UDP broadcast discovery for hotspot scenarios (port 5011)
  ADDED: Manual IP entry option in the Join screen for direct connection
  ADDED: Host screen now displays hotspot IP address and port for easy sharing
  CHANGED: Client now listens for both multicast and broadcast beacons simultaneously
